Federated Learning for Low-Power Edge Devices

Priya Sharma; Tom Becker

Abstract:

Federated learning lets devices train a shared model without sharing data, but low-power devices struggle with the communication cost. We propose a compression scheme that cuts uplink traffic by 90% with less than 1% accuracy loss on three benchmark datasets.
Published in: IEEE Internet of Things Journal ( Volume: 10, Issue: 4, 15 February 2023)
Page(s): 3301 - 3315
DOI: 10.1109/JIOT.2022.3210000
Publisher: IEEE
SECTION I.

Introduction

Edge devices are everywhere.

SECTION V.

Conclusion

We showed that aggressive update compression makes federated learning practical on low-power edge devices.

Future work will study energy use on real hardware.
